proposed_widenings.name: resource_backed_spell_access_bundle
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants a shared charge pool and recharge cadence for several spells, but those spells keep their own casting-time procedures. The current magic-item activation family requires one shared activationCost for the whole item, which would misencode Shield as an action-like activation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can press one of those faces, expend the number of charges required for it, and thereby cast the spell associated with it (save DC 17)... Mage Armor, Shield, Tiny Hut, Private Sanctum, Resilient Sphere, Wall of Force.

notes: Top-level kind `magic_item` exists, and `grant_spell_access` plus fixed `dcOverride` already cover most payload details. The honest blocker is family fit: one shared item activation cost cannot represent a bundle that includes both reaction-timed and non-reaction spells while also sharing one charge pool.
